chapters.title: The birth of Jesus
chapters.summary: Matthew traces Jesus' family line from Abraham through David. An angel tells Joseph that Mary's child is from the Holy Spirit and will save His people from their sins: Emmanuel, God with us.

chapters.title: The wise men
chapters.summary: Wise men follow a star to worship the newborn King. Herod tries to kill the child, but Joseph takes the family to Egypt and later settles in Nazareth.

chapters.title: John the Baptist
chapters.summary: John preaches repentance in the wilderness: the kingdom of heaven is at hand. He baptizes Jesus, the Spirit descends like a dove, and a voice says, This is my beloved Son.

chapters.title: Temptation and first disciples
chapters.summary: Jesus is tempted by the devil in the wilderness and answers each time with Scripture. He begins preaching in Galilee and calls fishermen: follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

chapters.title: The Beatitudes
chapters.summary: The Sermon on the Mount begins: blessed are the poor in spirit, the meek, the merciful, the peacemakers. You are the salt of the earth and the light of the world. Love your enemies.

chapters.title: The Lord's Prayer
chapters.summary: Give, pray and fast in secret, not for show. Jesus teaches the Lord's Prayer and says: do not worry about tomorrow, but seek first the kingdom of God.

chapters.title: Ask, seek, knock
chapters.summary: Do not judge. Ask, seek and knock. Treat others as you want to be treated. Build your life on Jesus' words, like a house built on rock.

chapters.title: Healings and a storm
chapters.summary: Jesus heals a leper, a centurion's servant and Peter's mother-in-law. He calms a storm on the lake and frees two men from demons.

chapters.title: Mercy, not sacrifice
chapters.summary: Jesus forgives and heals a paralyzed man, calls Matthew the tax collector, heals a bleeding woman and raises a girl. The harvest is plentiful but the workers are few.

chapters.title: The twelve sent out
chapters.summary: Jesus sends out the twelve apostles with authority, warning of persecution. Not a sparrow falls without your Father; you are worth more than many sparrows.

chapters.title: Come to me, all who labor
chapters.summary: Jesus answers John the Baptist's question with His works and rebukes unrepentant towns. Come to me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

chapters.title: Lord of the Sabbath
chapters.summary: Jesus heals on the Sabbath and is accused of working by Beelzebub. A tree is known by its fruit, and whoever does God's will is His family.

chapters.title: Parables of the kingdom
chapters.summary: Jesus teaches in parables: the sower, the weeds, the mustard seed, the yeast, the hidden treasure and the pearl of great price.

chapters.title: Feeding five thousand
chapters.summary: John the Baptist is beheaded. Jesus feeds five thousand with five loaves and two fish, then walks on water. Peter steps out, sinks, and Jesus catches him.

chapters.title: What defiles a person
chapters.summary: What defiles is what comes out of the heart, not unwashed hands. A Canaanite woman's faith is honored, and Jesus feeds four thousand.

chapters.title: You are the Christ
chapters.summary: Peter confesses, "Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God." Jesus foretells His death and says whoever would follow Him must take up their cross.

chapters.title: The transfiguration
chapters.summary: On a mountain Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James and John, with Moses and Elijah. He heals a boy and says faith as small as a mustard seed can move mountains.

chapters.title: Forgive seventy times seven
chapters.summary: Become like little children. The shepherd seeks the lost sheep. Forgive not seven times but seventy times seven, as the parable of the unforgiving servant shows.

chapters.title: The rich young man
chapters.summary: Jesus teaches on marriage and blesses children. A rich young man goes away sad. With God all things are possible, and the first shall be last.

chapters.title: To serve, not be served
chapters.summary: Workers in a vineyard all receive the same wage. James and John ask for the best seats, but Jesus came not to be served but to serve and give His life.

chapters.title: The triumphal entry
chapters.summary: Jesus enters Jerusalem on a donkey to cries of Hosanna, clears the temple, curses a fig tree, and tells parables against the religious leaders.

chapters.title: The greatest commandment
chapters.summary: A parable of a wedding feast. Render unto Caesar what is Caesar's. The greatest commandments: love God with all your heart and love your neighbor as yourself.

chapters.title: Woe to the hypocrites
chapters.summary: Jesus condemns the scribes and Pharisees for hypocrisy, then grieves over Jerusalem like a hen longing to gather her chicks.

chapters.title: Signs of the end
chapters.summary: On the Mount of Olives Jesus foretells the temple's destruction, troubles to come and His return. Heaven and earth will pass away, but His words will not.

chapters.title: Ready for His return
chapters.summary: Parables of the ten bridesmaids and the talents, and the sheep and the goats: whatever you did for the least of these, you did for me.

chapters.title: The Last Supper and Gethsemane
chapters.summary: A woman anoints Jesus and Judas agrees to betray Him. At the Passover meal Jesus gives the bread and cup. He prays in Gethsemane, not my will but yours, and is arrested. Peter denies Him.

chapters.title: The crucifixion
chapters.summary: Jesus is handed to Pilate, who releases Barabbas. Jesus is mocked and crucified, cries out, "My God, why hast thou forsaken me?" and dies. The centurion says, Truly this was the Son of God.

chapters.title: He is risen
chapters.summary: At dawn the women find the tomb empty; an angel says, He is not here, for He is risen. Jesus meets His disciples and sends them to make disciples of all nations: I am with you always.
